business_overview.one_sentence: Fenbi provides vocational education and recruitment examination tutoring services in China, with book sales as a secondary revenue line.

segments.business_substance: Online, offline and integrated small-class recruitment examination tutoring services.
Textbooks and learning materials sold standalone or with tutoring services.

business_overview.revenue_model: Course fees for tutoring services and sales proceeds from textbooks/learning materials.
business_notes: Contract liabilities represent prepaid course fees for unsatisfied performance obligations.
Refund liabilities relate to customers' right of refund on prepaid or provided courses.

gaps: Cash, deposits and wealth management products are not fully split by legal entity, parent/subsidiary/VIE location or repatriation path.
Term deposits are disclosed as initial term over three months, but exact maturity ladder is not disclosed in the extracted notes.
FVTPL wealth management product issuer, principal protection and redemption terms are not fully disclosed.
Complete three-year operating cash flow and capital expenditure series is not available in this annual report; only 2022 and 2023 cash-flow statement columns are present.
